title: Unauthenticated reflected XSS in Essity "Network Toolbox" CGI (████████ ████████
vulnerability_information:
## Summary Legacy Perl "Network Toolbox" CGI at `████████` reflects `packet_size` into the HTML response without output encoding. When `packet_size` is non-integer, the script echoes the raw value inside an `

` error element, allowing arbitrary HTML/JS injection. No auth required; no CSP on the response. ## Steps to reproduce Unauthenticated URL (browser or curl): ``` ████████?action=Run_Cmd&ip=1.1.1.1&packet_size=%3Cscript%3Ealert(document.domain)%3C%2Fscript%3E&cmd=+Ping+ ``` curl: ```bash curl -sk '████████?action=Run_Cmd&ip=1.1.1.1&packet_size=%3Cscript%3Ealert(document.domain)%3C%2Fscript%3E&cmd=+Ping+' \ -H 'X-HackerOne-Research: larocas' ``` Reflection gated on `action=Run_Cmd` + non-integer `packet_size`; GET and POST both work. ████████ Encoding proof: - `packet_size=RAWTEST` reflected literally as `RAWTEST` (no `<i>`). - `packet_size=` reflected raw inside `

`. ## Impact Arbitrary JS in the Essity-owned origin `████████` against any visitor following a crafted link (no auth, no cookie). Enables phishing under an Essity domain, content injection/defacement, theft of anything scriptable from the origin. Absent CSP + legacy internet-facing mirror of internal SCA/SGN tool compound exposure. ## Secondary info disclosure on same page (low on its own) Public page source leaks internal infra (non-qualifying alone, worth remediating with the XSS): internal host `████████`, internal mgmt IP `████████`, SNMP read-only community `████████`, server path `████████`, internal contact `████████`.
